name: PHRX 5149
title: Professional Experience in Critical Care II
description: The student will apply knowledge, skills and attitudes to the provision of care in a unique critical care setting. Emphasis is on development of optimizing medication-related outcomes in patients through medication therapy management, interprofessional collaboration, and may include patient/caregiver education. Direct patient care.
requirement_description: PHRX 5047 or PHRX 5065; open to students in the School of Pharmacy.
